prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high, except for the grid view pet companion redesign where the prediction was too low.
Grid view pet companion redesign and clear re-authentication sign-in copy were helpful.
Adding new screens (validation stage or personality selection) performed worse.
Reordering onboarding flow to narrative-first performed worse, while deferring sign-in showed no clear effect.
Adding hints, shortcut guides, notifications, status banners, or wait info showed no clear effect.
Simplifying path choice layout showed no clear effect, while most other redesigns had no clear effect or performed worse.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -14.7% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +6.9% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +3.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -3.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -4.3% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -7.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +4.8% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -2.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.4% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 75.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.1%

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Two Column Path Choice View: Redesign the choose_path screen into a two-column layout contrasting quick companion selection directly against custom photo creation. (why: 23.8% dropoff on choose_path with a high mean time of 514s indicates decision confusion when choosing between setup paths.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Centered Account Authentication Layout: Redesign the sign-in screen to a clean centered layout emphasizing account synchronization and direct single-click login options. (why: Sign-in drops 24.8% of users, and 8 support tickets cited missing or reset pets due to re-authenticating under wrong accounts.)
2: [home, redesign] Split Waiting View Layout: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout placing asset generation status side-by-side with desktop rendering status. (why: The home waiting stage has a 18.7% dropoff and an average wait time of 2336s, while users report pets failing to spawn.)
3: [finish, redesign] Card Layout Home Intro Overview: Redesign the home_intro screen into a card layout highlighting essential controls to summon, move, and hide the desktop pet. (why: The finish step has the lowest conversion at 64.8%, and users wrote support emails expressing confusion on controlling or hiding the pet.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Direct Journey Selection Headline Copy: Update the story screen copy to clearly outline the difference between quick adoption and custom generation before choosing. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing users spend significant time trying to understand what each path requires.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Add a prominent hint below sign-in options reminding returning users to sign in with their original provider to sync existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different or fresh account.)
6: [adoption, copy] Upload Photo Clarity Guidelines Copy: Rewrite upload_photos text with explicit tips on lighting and angles to ensure accurate pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, causing abandonment during adoption.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Stage Progress Indicator: Enable step counter and estimated time display on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: High mean waiting time (2336s) causes users to think the app stalled before the pet appears on the desktop.)
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Copy: Update home_intro headline and body text to clearly explain how to right-click, move, or hide the pet on the desktop. (why: Support receives emails from users unsure how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after completing onboarding.)
